pages.ja:
森を走る。
前には先行する遠坂の背中。
背後には、木々をすり抜けて追ってくるアサシンの気配。

pages.en:
We race through the forest.

Tohsaka runs ahead of me.

Behind us, I can feel Assassin slipping between the trees in pursuit.
pages.mirrorMoon:
We run through the forest.
In front of me is Tohsaka, leading the way.
Behind us is Assassin, pursuing us through the trees.

pages.ja:
「衛宮くん、後ろ……！」
俺たちが気になるのか、とっくに逃げ出せた筈の遠坂は速度を緩めて振り向く。

「衛宮くん、後ろ……！」

pages.en:
“Emiya, behind you…!”

Perhaps worried about us, Tohsaka slows and looks back, though she should have been able to escape long ago.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Behind you, Emiya-kun…!”
She must be worried about us. Even though she could’ve escaped by now, she slows down and turns to look at us.

pages.ja:
「っ……！」

だが振り払えない。
追っ手はアサシンのサーヴァントだ。
イリヤを連れた状態ではどうやって振り払

But I cannot shake him.

Our pursuer is the Servant Assassin.

With Illya in my arms, how can I possibly outrun—

短剣を舐め笑う、白い髑髏の面があった。

An ominous voice sounds beside my ear.

I glance sideways and find—

a white skull mask grinning as Assassin licks the edge of his dagger.

When I look to my side…

！？」

Assassin had been running abreast of us, but a kick to the flank sends him hurtling aside.
pages.mirrorMoon:

pages.ja:

pages.jaRuby:

“…Hmph. If an ambush is the only way you can take a boy's head, you are third-rate indeed.”

Archer does not break stride as he speaks.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Hah. So you cannot even kill a kid unless you attack him by surprise, you third-rate?”
Archer does not slacken his pace as he talks.

“Archer…!?”

pages.en:
We break free of the forest with the clamor of crossing blades behind us.

Assassin continues his pursuit, trading blows with Archer as Archer holds him back.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I go through the forest with the sound of clashing swords at my back.
As Assassin follows, he is obstructed by Archer’s efforts.

“Ngh, guh—”

Unable to press the attack, Assassin is forced back yet again.

Their exchange is evenly matched.

Even the daggers he flings at me whenever he sees an opening are struck from the air. By every appearance, Assassin has reached an impasse.

But not because Assassin is weak.

Their attacks are matched.
Even the daggers thrown at me are shot down, and it’s obvious that Assassin is not in control of the fight.
But it’s not because Assassin is weak.

His vigor is incomparable to before.
The scales of victory are tipping towards Archer.
I don’t know why, but he is as strong as a fierce god right now.

In other words”

The black Servant escapes Archer and disappears into the darkness among the trees.
